title: Nanhe mujahid ran me jaaker
body:
Nanhe mujahid ran me jaaker
Haa..n haa...n
Shaah to aae jaane madar
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe mujahid ran me jakar
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aaye
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Kabse khadi hu khaime ke dar par..(2)
aankho me lekar ashko ke sagar..(2)
pesh karu aajao jo asghar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khali jo pehlu paungi beta..(2)
ghum se phatega mera kaleja..(2)
raat bhi guzregi ro ro kar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Raat andheri dashte bayabaa..(2)
darr nahi jana ran me meri jaa..(2)
kaise rahoge maa se bichad kar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tumne isharo me ye kaha tha..(2)
dedo raza maqtal ki khudara..(2)
fatha mai karke aaunga lashkar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Haste hue khaimo se sidhare..(2)
peshe nazar hai saare nazare..(2)
sogaye kya maidaan me jakar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Teer laga hai kya gardan par..(2)
jo nahi dekha maa ko palatkar..(2)
kaunsi majburi thi asghar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Kisko sunaungi mai kahani..(2)
ye bhi na socha yusuf e saani..(2)
maa se kategi raat ye kyu kar..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Kisne anees e ghum ko pukara..(2)
sunwao awaaz dobara..(2)
nauha yahi tha bano ke lab par..(2)
<<MINI>>
tum nahi aae
<<DIVIDER>>
